item.title: 35 Years, a ₹2 Doctor Couple, 1 Village Reborn
item.description: #thebetterindia For 35 years, Dr. Ravindra and Dr. Smita Kolhe’s fee was just ₹2. But their true gift wasn’t in the charge—it was in the care. In Bairagarh, a village with no roads or doctors, they fought poverty, transformed healthcare, and slashed infant mortality from 200 to under 40.
